The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
nameNote: the statement carried only its ticker as the name; the name is taken from the exchange listing for HMCALL
periods_note: profit before tax and profit after tax for FY2023 to FY2021 come from the audited five year financial summary. Operating profit left empty for those years because the summary discloses no finance cost line, so EBIT cannot be stated without assuming it.
